properties.text: A Russian milblogger claimed on August 28 that Russian forces advanced west of Charivne (east of Orikhiv), north of Novodanylivka (southeast of Orikhiv), and into central Bilohirya (southeast of Orikhiv).[67] Ukrainian forces continued their intermediate-range strike campaign against Russian military assets in occupied Zaporizhia Oblast.

ISW has not observed evidence to assess that Russian forces have a presence (either through advances or infiltrations) in Pyskunivka, Pershomarivka, or Orikhuvatkha, and that Russian forces have advanced to roughly 14 kilometers from both Slovyansk and Kramatorsk.

Ukrainian forces recently advanced southwest of Dvorichna (north of Kupyansk), according to geolocated footage published on August 25.[29] Russian reporting indicates that Ukrainian forces are likely advancing southeast of Borova.

A Kremlin-affiliated milblogger claimed on August 25 that Ukrainian forces counterattacked near Katerynivka, Nove, and Ridkodub (all southeast of Borova) and seized the area between Nove and Katerynivka.[30] The milblogger claimed that Russian forces near the Shandryholove salient (south of Borova) are under threat of Ukrainian encirclement and assessed that Russian forces are likely losing control of Shandryholove.
